## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}
library(sf)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(leaflet)

analytic_file <- "H:/github_repos/Assignment_MMAH/data/processed/final_analytic_dataset.csv"

# Point this to the .shp file you downloaded
boundary_file <- "C:/Users/shahki/Downloads/lcsd000b21a_e/lcsd000b21a_e.shp"


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Read analytic data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

analytic_data <- fread(
  analytic_file,
  encoding = "Latin-1"
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(

    # Extract 7-digit Census Subdivision identifier
    CSDUID = str_sub(
      as.character(DGUID),
      -7
    ),

    # Calculate affordability measures
    affordability_30plus =
      100 *
      (`30% to less than 50%` + `50% or more`) /
      `Total - Shelter-cost-to-income ratio`,

    affordability_50plus =
      100 *
      `50% or more` /
      `Total - Shelter-cost-to-income ratio`
    
  )
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
csd <- st_read(
  boundary_file,
  quiet = TRUE
)


ontario_csd <- csd %>%
  filter(
    PRUID == "35"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    CSDUID = as.character(CSDUID)
  )

map_data <- ontario_csd %>%
  left_join(
    analytic_data,
    by = "CSDUID"
  )



```



```{r}


# Make sure geometry is valid and in longitude/latitude
map_data_leaflet <- map_data %>%
  sf::st_make_valid() %>%
  sf::st_transform(4326)


ap_data_leaflet <- map_data %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%

  # Use a projected coordinate system so tolerance is in metres
  st_transform(3347) %>%

  # Simplify boundaries: 500 m is usually plenty for an Ontario-wide map
  st_simplify(
    dTolerance = 500,
    preserveTopology = TRUE
  ) %>%

  # Leaflet requires longitude/latitude
  st_transform(4326)

pal_30 <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "magma",
  domain = map_data$affordability_30plus,
  na.color = "#E5E5E5"
)

```


```{r leaflet_plot}

leaflet(ap_data_leaflet) %>%
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal_30(affordability_30plus),
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    color = "white",
    weight = 0.4,
    label = ~paste0(
      CSDNAME, ": ",
      round(affordability_30plus, 1), "%"
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    pal = pal_30,
    values = ~affordability_30plus,
    title = "Households<br>spending ≥30%"
  )  %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      var legend = el.querySelector('.legend');
      if (legend) {
        legend.style.transform = 'translateX(-70px)';
      }
    }
  ")
```
